name: student_analyze
description: Analyze a student by stable user_id across papers, with each score and rank compared only to that paper's recorded cohort. Optional paper, category and group filters. Does not average incomparable raw scores across papers. Requires reading the whole selected cohort. Gateway requests are GET-only to the activation-configured HTTPS origin; it never follows redirects or contacts iaaa.gbu.edu.cn. Browser authentication, including session reuse and any SSO navigation, uses visible Chromium only.
